caveats: Liquid's own benchmark rig (Pipette); no independent run on this hardware yet.
The card names the chip (AMD Ryzen AI Max+ 395) but not its memory size or the llama.cpp build.
The card's command gives no quant tag; llama.cpp's -hf picks Q4_K_M by default when the repo has one, which matches the benchmarked quant.
License is Liquid's LFM Open License v1.0, not Apache-2.0: commercial use is licensed only for organisations under $10M annual revenue.
Not recommended on its own for knowledge-heavy tasks (Liquid's card): pair it with retrieval or web search.
